_help: Block world (scripts/Block*.cs, docs/DESIGN.md 'Block world'). Every block type is listed under 'blocks'; adding one needs no code. Fields: n name; solid (false = walk through); fluid ('water' or 'lava'); see (see-through: faces behind it are drawn); hardness (seconds to break by hand, -1 = unbreakable); tool (pickaxe, shovel, axe or '' = any); drops (a block id, a material id from data/gather.json, or '' for nothing) and dropChance; burn (seconds it burns, 0 = not flammable) and burnsTo; meltsTo (fire, holy); freezesTo (frost); rotsTo (poison); withersTo (shadow); blessTo (holy); packsTo (earth skills); shatter (lightning breaks it at once); slippery; light (glow 0..1); mat = how it looks: {gothic: a material in assets/materials/gothic, tex: a texture folder/name in assets/textures, gfx: a generated texture kind, color tint, tile metres, alpha, glow}, or top/side/bottom for different faces.

world._help: chunk = blocks per chunk side; radius = chunks loaded around the player in each direction (the rest of the world stays the smooth far terrain); minY/maxY = bedrock floor and build ceiling; dirtDepth = blocks of subsoil under the top block; bedrock = layers of bedrock at the bottom; meshPerFrame = finished chunk meshes put in the scene per frame; tick = seconds between water/fire updates, maxFluid/maxFire = cells updated per tick at most, maxBurning = blocks on fire at once.

surface._help: what the top block is for each ground type the game already knows (World.SurfaceAt / Lands.StepSurface), what lies under it, and the beds under water

ores._help: ores in the stone: chance per stone block deeper than 'below' blocks under the surface

dig._help: digging by hand: hold attack in build mode. time = hardness / speed; speed 1 by hand, 'toolSpeed' with the right tool. Weapons count as tools: 'tools' maps a tool to weapon types.

power._help: How hits change the world. strength = damage x mul (enemyMul for monsters, basicMul for plain attacks). A block breaks when strength x falloff >= its hardness x hardnessCost; falloff goes from 1 at the centre to 1 - edgeLoss at the edge. Crater radius = the hit's area x areaMul (pointRadius for single-target hits) x clamp(strength / refStrength, minScale, maxScale), at most maxRadius; at most maxBlocks per hit. Monsters never break more than enemyMaxHardness, nor floors in dungeons; bosses at most bossMaxRadius. dropChance = chance a block broken by a hit drops.

elements._help: what each damage type does to blocks within the hit's area (+reach). ignite = chance to set a flammable block burning; melt/freeze/rot/wither/bless/pack = chance to turn a block into its meltsTo/freezesTo/rotsTo/withersTo/blessTo/packsTo; frozen = seconds blocks stay frozen (slippery, half as hard); shatter = breaks 'shatter' blocks.

fire._help: a burning block spreads to each flammable neighbour with 'spread' chance per second, then becomes its burnsTo when its burn time ends; it melts snow and ice next to it

fluids._help: flow: water spreads 'spread' blocks sideways from a source, falls without limit, and two sources side by side over solid ground make a new one (so holes by a lake fill back up). Lava spreads less and slower (every 'slow' ticks). Lava touching water: a lava source becomes obsidian, flowing lava becomes stone. swim: how the player moves in water; lavaDps = damage per second standing in lava.

build._help: blocks you can place in build mode cycle with the mouse wheel; the first owned one is chosen

recipes._help: crafting window, Blocks tab: what you get from what you pay (block ids from this file or materials from data/gather.json)
